market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Cautiously bullish, awaiting a follow-through day. "This would be the fourth day of the rally… if we get above 1% today, that would constitute a follow-through day, and you should be adding stocks to your portfolio" (David Ryan). The equal-weighted S&P 500 (RSP) and QQQE are well above the 50-day, showing broad strength beyond mega-caps. Hatman noted bullish sentiment is subdued (AAII bulls at 31%, Investors Intelligence at 49%), a contrarian positive.

DDOG.technical_action: Cup-with-handle breakout. 5% ATR. Use 7-8% stop. Hatman notes 35-36% CAGR history.
DDOG.story: AI-powered cloud monitoring. Strong long-term leader.

CRWD.technical_action: Undercut a prior base, held 50-day, then broke out. David Ryan accumulated over 5 days. Now extended.
CRWD.story: Cybersecurity leader. Bots escaping and attacking other companies is a catalyst.

PANW.technical_action: Held 50-day, inside day, then moved up. Ryan bought it.
PANW.story: Cybersecurity. A strong peer in the same group.

FTNT.technical_action: Huge post-earnings reversal and failure. Fallen below key levels.
FTNT.story: Cybersecurity. The former leader of the group has broken down.

AIR.technical_action: Bounce off 50-day, Chris building a small position. Low volume/gappy.
AIR.story: Aerospace parts/services. Solid numbers, sector tailwind.

GE.technical_action: Approaching cup-with-handle buy point. Early entry was yesterday.
GE.story: Aerospace giant. Post-breakup value unlock, strong sector.

GOOGL.technical_action: Double-bottom breakout, reclaiming 50-day. Leaderboard added at 373.75.
GOOGL.story: AI/Cloud mega-cap. Sentiment shift back to favoring AI spending.

AMZN.story: Mega-cap e-commerce/AWS. Market now rewarding CapEx again.

TWST.story: DNA on silicon chips. Emerging leader. Wait for a pullback or break above $100.

AMD.technical_action: At the 50-day line, reporting earnings after close.
AMD.story: Chip designer. Wait for the news to digest. A trendline break could be an early entry.

HPE.story: AI server/edge. A relatively strong AI play in a messy sector.

MU.technical_action: Chris is actively hedging with puts. Still holding a core.

FIX.story: HVAC/data center services. A classic short setup on the rejection of the 50-day.

VIK.technical_action: Breaking out of a cup-with-handle. David Ryan bought a few days ago.
